g.text: Frequency and harmonic-complexity sensitivity · unchanged LIVE kernel
Original deterministic synthetic sources; piano-like is synthesis, not an acoustic recording.
Identical delay-aligned inputs. RMS matching is not LUFS matching. Numerical difference is not a quality score.
Harmonics above Nyquist are omitted; nominal eight-partial probes contain fewer partials at high fundamentals.
